name: Create Darkness
effect: Completely darkens an area within the specified radius. Everything within the area is perceived as though on a dark and moonless night.

name: Induce Fear
effect: Temporarily causes the state of Fear in all people within the area. The caster decides what the victims are afraid of. The effects can be avoided with a successful MR or PsR check.

name: See in Darkness
effect: Permits the caster or anyone they select to see perfectly in natural darkness. This spell can only affect a number of individuals whose combined presence is under a limit determined by the level of the spell.

arcane.description: 140 presence limit, and the effect works in supernatural Darkness.

name: Shield of Darkness
effect: Forms an energy barrier that protects from any source of attack. The shield has a number of Life Points determined by the level of the spell, but is only damaged by supernatural attacks. Any attack based on Light deals double damage.

name: Shadow
effect: Increases the caster's ability to conceal, boosting their Secondary Abilities of Stealth and Hide by a specified amount. It also increases their Magic Appraisal by this amount, but only for the purposes of hiding the magical potency of something or someone, not for the purposes of detecting it.

name: Armor of Darkness
effect: Forms a layer of mystical armor with an AT against all types of damage, and a higher amount for attacks on the Energy table. Although this counts as a layer of armor, it does not count as an additional layer for the purposes of initiative penalties.

name: Banish Light
effect: Destroys ambient light within the specified radius. Any Light based creatures within the radius must pass a MR check or lose double their failure level in Life Points (Damage Resistant creatures increase this amount by their Damage Resistance Multiple). If this spell is maintained over the creatures, they must make a new MR check each combat turn.

name: Hide Magic
effect: Hides a spell, or the mystical properties of an object, from any type of magical detection. In game terms, it produces a penalty to the Magic Appraisal Secondary Ability of anyone attempting to detect or measure a spell or object affected by this spell. This effect also hides the Hide Magic spell itself from being detected.

name: Dark Beam
effect: Projects a beam of Darkness based magical energy. This is an attack of the Energy type with a base damage determined by the level of the spell when cast.

name: Darkzone
effect: Creates a mystical environment that clouds the senses of anyone within it. The Darkzone increases the difficulty of any Perceptive check within it by 2 difficulty levels. This ability also affects Ki Detection, as well as Magical and Psychic detection abilities. The spell has an area defined by the level of the spell, and it is not possible to designate targets within it. No Resistance is possible to this effect.

name: Bonds of Darkness
effect: Creates bonds of Darkness that hold the designated target immobile. An attack is made using the rules for Trapping, although the caster suffers no penalty to their ability for performing this maneuver. The bonds use a strength value for the Trapping check based on the level of the spell, and are treated as an Energy item with a fortitude of 25.

name: Control Darkness
effect: Modifies and controls the form or intensity of darkness in the specified radius. If any Darkness based beings are in the area, they must pass a MR check with difficulty determined by the level of the spell, or fall under control of the caster. A creature can only repeat the check if ordered to do something against its nature.

name: Concealment
effect: Conceals the presence of the caster or a target designated by them from any type of detection. In game terms, it increases the resistance of the target to supernatural (both mystical and psychic) detection, as well as to their ability of Ki Concealment, and allows the target to use that ability even if it is not otherwise developed.

name: Obfuscate
effect: Modifies the body of the individual, blending them into the background and permitting them to hide themselves naturally. While the spell is active, the person can exchange their own level of ability for Stealth, Hide, and Ki Concealment for the specified value based on the level of the spell. This also permits the target to use Ki Concealment even if that ability is not otherwise developed.

name: Enrage
effect: Provokes the Rage status in those affected, making them lose control and attack the closest person. The spell's victims apply a +10 bonus to any offensive ability or action and a -30 penalty to any other check or action. Enrage has a radius determined by the level of the spell, with no targets being designated within. To resist the effects of this spell, one must pass a MR check.

name: Banish Positive Emotions
effect: Temporarily banishes any positive sentiments such as inner peace, calm, or joy within the specified radius of the caster. Resisting the spell requires a successful MR or PsR check.

name: Night
effect: Forms a dome of darkness with a maximum radius determined by the level of the spell. Everyone in the interior, except for the caster, is subject to the rules for blindness. To see through the darkness, whether from inside or outside the dome, requires a Notice check of Impossible (280) difficulty, or an Absurd (180) Search check.

initial.description: 25m Radius, the dome is considered natural darkness.

advanced.description: 500m Radius, the dome is considered supernatural darkness.

name: Dark Sphere
effect: Unleashes a sphere of dark energy with a base damage determined by the level of the spell. The caster can control it using their own magic projection until it hits its target. If the target successfully dodges, the Dark Sphere can continue to attack on the following turn, as it has not been destroyed. When the Dark Sphere causes damage or is successfully blocked, it explodes and vanishes. If the caster wishes they can abandon active control of it, and it will continue to attack independently with a separate magic projection based on the level of the spell.

name: Zone of Concealment
effect: The caster creates a mystical area that impedes detection of anything within it. Anything within the area is concealed, applying a bonus to their MR and PsR to avoid detection. Similarly, those attempting to use Ki Detection or Magic appraisal upon those in the area suffer a penalty to their ability. Once cast, the zone remains stationary regardless of the movement of the caster.

initial.description: 20m Radius, +100 to resistances, -140 to detection abilities.

intermediate.description: 80m Radius, +150 to resistances, -180 to detection abilities.

advanced.description: 250m Radius, +200 to resistances, -240 to detection abilities.

arcane.description: 500m Radius, +300 to resistances, -320 to detection abilities

name: Enter Another's Nightmares
effect: Allows the caster to physically enter a sleeper's dreams. The caster has no control over the dream world of the dreamer, and anything that happens there will be real for the caster. The person must have terrible nightmares to be affected by this spell, and the moment the dream becomes peaceful, or if the target awakens or dies, the caster abandons the dream world and returns to reality. Any spiritual spell cast on the dreamer while the caster is present in the dream will also affect the caster. The spell can be resisted with a successful MR or PsR check. Once in the target's dreams, the caster can 'jump' to the unconscious of yet another dreamer who is physically nearby, as determined by the level of the spell. Naturally, this new target will have their own resistance check. If the dreamer's consciousness happens to be transported to the wake, the caster is trapped there even if the spell expires.

name: Dark Form
effect: The body designated by the caster is transformed into pure dark energy and becomes intangible to physical and non-energy attacks. While in this state, the transformed person gains a bonus to their secondary abilities of Stealth and Hide, and a bonus to resistances against any effect based on Darkness, however any damage caused by attacks based on Light are doubled.

initial.description: +50 to Stealth and Hide, +20 to Resistances.

intermediate.description: +60 to Stealth and Hide, +30 to Resistances.

advanced.description: As Intermediate, but resistance bonus applies to all effects not based on Light.

arcane.description: As Advanced, but doesn't suffer double damage from Light based attacks.

name: Perdition
effect: Causes those around the caster to feel disturbed and uneasy, reducing their abilities. Those within the area must succeed at an MR check or suffer an all action penalty. The area is always around the caster and targets cannot be specified within it. Characters cannot suffer from the effects of more than 1 Perdition spell at any time.

name: Create Negative Feelings
effect: Creates negative sentiments such as fear, hatred, or anger in people designated by the caster within the spell's radius. Those affected can resist the spell by passing a MR or PsR check, and are allowed to repeat the check once per day.

name: Erase Traces
effect: The caster can erase any evidence that they have been in a certain place or area. Any sign of their passage, whether detectable naturally or by supernatural means, disappears completely. This spell provides immunity to all detection, including a Zen level Track check. The only exception is if the tracker is able to see into the past, before the spell was cast at all.

advanced.description: 1km area, even the caster's past presence is erased.

arcane.description: 5km area, the traces of the entire area's past are erased.

name: Shield from Positive
effect: Enchants a designated area, making it impenetrable for beings based naturally on positive emotions or Light. Any such creature entering the zone must pass a MR check or suffer loss of Life Points equal to the margin of failure. Additionally, upon failing the check, such a creature receives an immediate -40 All Action Penalty. The affected zone has a radius determined by the level of the spell, and is stationary in the place it is cast.

name: Dark
effect: Creates a shield of shadows with the ability to swallow any attack spell received. For absorption of the attacking spell to work, it must successfully block the attack, and the attacking spell must lose a Spell Clash against a spell with an equivalent base damage designated by the spell level. The Dark absorbs half of the Zeon of the devoured spell, giving those points to the caster. It is also possible to devour area attacks in this way. Like other supernatural shields, it has a number of Life Points determined by the level of the spell.

name: Devastate
effect: Causes penalties through accumulation of pain, suffering, misery, and other mystical negative consequences. The affected person must succeed at an MR check or suffer an all action penalty and a penalty to resistances equal to the margin of failure. Once failed, the target has no new opportunity to resist as long as the spell is maintained.

name: Mark of Fear
effect: Forms a display of multitudinous shadows in a designated location and terrorizes all who see it. Anyone directly viewing the Mark of Fear suffers the Terror status unless they succeed at an MR or PsR check. The spell is visible for a radius determined by the level of the spell.

name: Catastrophic Darkness
effect: Creates a deadly discharge of Darkness with a base damage and area determined by the level of the spell. This is an attack on the Energy table.

name: Dark Material Objects
effect: Forms a material object from dark energy. Whether it is something as complex as a clock, or as simple as a sword. The object cannot exceed the presence limit determined by the level of the spell, but is treated as a quality item. As an exception to the normal rule, the quality of this object does not affect its presence.

name: Travel by Shadow
effect: Transports individuals or objects designated by the caster from one shadow to another that must be within a set distance. The quantity of presence that can be transported this way is increased with each level of the spell. If one wishes to resist the effect, they must succeed at an MR check.

name: Lord of Nightmares
effect: Permits control over any type of nightmare of an individual that does not succeed at an MR check. The caster will have the ability to control the dream world of the sleeper as if they were an entity with Gnosis 45. In the event that the dream is no longer fed by negative energy – that is, ceases to be a nightmare, their Gnosis is only 30. Spells that the sorcerer is able to cast thanks only to their elevated Gnosis (such as divine magic) have no effect outside the spatial limits of the spell, and their effects vanish as soon as the caster leaves the dream or the Wake.

intermediate.description: 150 MR, If the caster is in the wake, they also control their surroundings as a being with Gnosis 40, as long as they are in an area fed by negative energy. In neutral areas, their Gnosis is only 30. This effect remains stationary to the area of the Wake when cast, and only if there are no similar entities in the area.

advanced.description: 160 MR, As Intermediate, but the caster has Gnosis 35 in neutral areas.

arcane.description: 180 MR, As Advanced, but the caster may influence all negative areas of the wake simultaneously.

name: Create Being of Darkness
effect: Creates a dark being with the appearance of life, but completely under the control of the caster. The entity is developed as a Being Between Worlds, using the powers and limitations of Darkness Elementals explained in Anima: Beyond Fantasy - Chapter 26: Creation of Beings. This creature has a number of Development Points based on the level of the spell, which dictates its level for the purposes of presence and abilities.

name: Concealment from Magic
effect: Hides the presence of the individual from Automatic spells, causing those spells to be ineffective against them. As an exception to the general rule, an opposing caster maintaining any Automatic spell must succeed in fixing their Magic Projection ability on the caster who is defending themselves using Concealment from Magic, as though the Automatic spell was a Spiritual type spell.

intermediate.description: Spells cast at Intermediate level or below.

advanced.description: Spells cast at Advanced level or below.

arcane.description: Spells cast at Arcane level or below.

name: Kingdom of Darkness
effect: Creates a zone around the caster in which total darkness reigns. The body of the caster blends into the shadows, requiring exceptional skill to detect them. To do so requires an Inhuman (320) Notice check, or an Impossible (280) Search check. For those using Ki Detection, a difficulty of Zen is required to separate the caster from the kingdom's energy. While merged with the Kingdom of Darkness, the caster can transport themselves anywhere within the area each combat turn. Those within the area lose 10 points of Zeon and 1 Ki point each combat turn, and any Light elemental suffers double the loss.

arcane.description: 1km Radius, grants the caster +30 to Magic Accumulation for Darkness spells.

name: Undetectable
effect: The target of this spell becomes completely undetectable to forms of supernatural ability. Depending on the level of the spell, using Magic, Ki, Psychic abilities, or other supernatural effects to detect the caster is completely ineffective.

initial.description: Cannot be detected by Magical or Psychic abilities.

intermediate.description: As Base, but also immune to Ki abilities.

advanced.description: As Intermediate, but also any additional supernatural detection.

arcane.description: As Advanced, but only Natural senses (sight, smell, hearing, etc.) are effective.

name: Prison of Darkness
effect: Encloses the victim in an inescapable world of darkness, a separate universe with no interaction with our own. While the victim is imprisoned, they will have no knowledge of anything that happens outside the prison, nor does anyone outside have knowledge of the prisoner. To break free, the prison is considered a damage resistant creature with AT 10, with a number of life points based on the level of the spell. However, any damage suffered from the outside is doubled automatically. The prison additionally recovers from damage with a regeneration value of 19. If the target of the spell fails an MR check, they are imprisoned and do not have the opportunity for a subsequent roll. If they wish to leave, they must break free from the prison. The caster may not lock themselves into their own Prison of Darkness.

arcane.description: The Prison cannot be broken from within, but possesses 500,000 Life Points for attacks from the outside, 240 MR

name: One with the Dark
effect: The caster enters a state of utter meditation where their body becomes one with the dark. They abandon this world and ascend into the flow of souls to nourish themselves from its energies, apart from, and without knowledge of anything happening elsewhere. In this state, they multiply their Zeon Regeneration rate by 10, and cure their wounds with Regeneration 16. Although there is no maintenance cost for this spell, the caster can be in the flow of souls for a time period determined by the level of the spell.

name: Dark Ascension
effect: Exchanges the material essence of a person for divine energy, modifying their spirit through pure supernatural power. While in this state, the caster or their target is imbued with elevated Gnosis determined by the level of the spell.

name: Holocaust of Darkness
effect: Unleashes the power of Darkness in its purest state, sweeping away everything in the spiritual as well as material world. The freed energy sweeps up and devours everything, unifying its existence to the Darkness. Even elemental creatures of Darkness are assimilated by its power. The Holocaust of Darkness creates a great shadowed dome within which everything is dissolved. It is an Energy attack with damage and radius determined by the level of the spell. Anyone receiving damage, regardless of the amount, must pass an MR check of difficulty 160 or be joined with the dark, and automatically be destroyed in both body and soul. It is not possible to designate targets within the radius of this spell; all except the caster are equally affected.
